items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Edgar Sampson, Elmer Williams, Truehart, John Kirby. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Got to be later than that too.

Kirpatrick came in in 1934. Now, let's see. And Tommy Fulford Wolpert was after Kirpatrick, and Arnold Arnell on out it seems. It seems that's what John Steel was with Chick when he had what was called "Chick Webb's Savoy Orchestra." This is a -- Renauld Jones, Taft Jordan, Sandy, Pete Clark, Edgar Sampson, Elmer Williams, Truehart, John Kirby. And then they had Chuck Richards or a vocalist.
